questions: Should the function handle XML namespaces, and if so, how should they be treated in the tag names used as DataFrame column headers?
If an 'item' element has nested child elements (i.e., grandchildren), should those be flattened, ignored, or cause an error?
If an 'item' element has attributes, should they be included as columns in the DataFrame?
If multiple 'item' elements have different sets of child tags, how should missing values be handled in the resulting DataFrame?
Should the text content of child elements be stripped of whitespace, or preserved exactly as in the XML?
If the XML contains CDATA sections within child elements, how should the text be extracted?
Should the order of rows in the DataFrame correspond to the document order of 'item' elements in the XML?
If the XML is valid but contains no root element (e.g., a fragment), should the function raise a ValueError?
